ORBHUD.Title: Orb HUD
ORBHUD.Settings.HotbarMode.Name: Core hotbar
ORBHUD.Settings.HotbarMode.Hint: What to do with Foundry's built-in macro hotbar so it doesn't collide with the Orb HUD.
ORBHUD.Settings.Position.Name: HUD position
ORBHUD.Settings.Position.Hint: Dock the HUD to the bottom or the top of the screen. At the top, the core hotbar is not moved.
ORBHUD.Settings.Scale.Name: HUD scale (%)
ORBHUD.Settings.Scale.Hint: Resize the whole HUD, from 75% to 150%.
ORBHUD.Settings.AlwaysNumbers.Name: Always show orb numbers
ORBHUD.Settings.AlwaysNumbers.Hint: Show the value / max inside the orbs at all times instead of only on hover.
ORBHUD.Settings.Policy.Name: Players may override
ORBHUD.Settings.Policy.Hint: Which orbs a player can reconfigure for actors they own.
ORBHUD.Settings.Config.Name: Orb configuration
ORBHUD.Settings.Config.Label: Configure orbs
ORBHUD.Settings.Config.Hint: Choose which actor fields feed the red and blue orbs, the shield pools, labels and colours.
ORBHUD.Bar.Missing: Missing item or macro (right-click to clear)
ORBHUD.Bar.UseFailed: Orb HUD could not use "{name}". See the console for details.
ORBHUD.Bar.OtherActor: You can only slot items from this actor.
ORBHUD.Config.Title: Orb HUD Configuration
ORBHUD.Config.WorldScope: World default: applies to every actor that has no override.
ORBHUD.Config.ActorScope: Override for {name}: saved on this actor and laid over the world default.
ORBHUD.Config.NoSample: no actor available, live values unavailable
ORBHUD.Config.Label: Label
ORBHUD.Config.Shields: Shields (drained first, summed into the shell)
ORBHUD.Config.NeedSource: Each orb needs a source before saving.
